mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=p.register_id AND f.item_type='处方' AND f.item_id=p.id AND f.fee_type='收费' AND f.fee_amount >= COALESCE(p.unit_price,d.drug_price)*CAST(p.drug_number AS DECIMAL(10,0)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fee_record rf WHERE rf.refund_target_id=f.id))
FROM prescription p JOIN drug_info d ON d.id=p.drug_id JOIN register r ON r.id=p.register_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.register_id AS `registerId`,p.drug_id AS `drugId`, p.drug_usage AS `drugUsage`,p.drug_number AS `drugNumber`,p.drug_state AS `drugState`,p.creation_time AS `creationTime`, COALESCE(p.unit_price,d.drug_price) AS `unitPrice`,d.drug_name AS `drugName`,d.drug_format AS `drugFormat`, d.drug_unit AS `drugUnit`,d.stock_quantity AS `stockQuantity`,r.case_number AS `caseNumber`,r.real_name AS `realName`,r.gender,r.age, e.realname AS `doctorName`,() AS paid LEFT JOIN employee e ON e.id=r.employee_id ORDER BY p.creation_time,p.id LIMIT #{offset},#{size}
SELECT register_id FROM prescription WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM prescription WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE prescription SET drug_state=#{next} WHERE id=#{id} AND drug_state=#{expected}
mapper.select: SELECT f.* FROM fee_record f WHERE f.register_id=#{registerId} AND f.item_type=#{type} AND f.item_id=#{itemId} AND f.fee_type='收费' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fee_record rf WHERE rf.refund_target_id=f.id) ORDER BY f.id
